inspiration.observed_pattern: PERCENTILE_CONT computes a continuous percentile with WITHIN GROUP ordering and partitions the result by a grouping field.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored station with four response readings so continuous median interpolation remains observable without copying source data.

fixture_notes: Four response-time readings make the continuous median an interpolation between the two middle values.
determinism_notes: All response rows, station code, reading numbers, percentile, partitioning, ordering, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE station_responses (response_id INT PRIMARY KEY, station_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, reading_no INT NOT NULL, response_ms DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT station_code, reading_no, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY station_code) AS median_response_ms FROM station_responses ORDER BY station_code, reading_no
